Set the default coding agent for Remotion Studio. Available coding agents: `codex, cursor, copilot, claude-code`.

## CLI flag

```text
--coding-agent <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDefaultCodingAgent('codex');
```
